```markdown
---
name: Feature / Requirement Implementation
about: Implements one or more REQ-* items from v2-requirements.md
---

## Summary
<one-sentence description of what this issue delivers>

## Requirements implemented
- REQ-<AREA>-<NN> — <title from reqs doc>
<!-- one line per REQ; usually just one -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Copy the AC bullets from the referenced REQ verbatim.
     Reviewers will check each box on merge. -->
- [ ] AC bullet 1
- [ ] AC bullet 2
- [ ] ...

## Dependencies
<!-- Other issues that must be closed before this one can start.
     Use "Blocked by #NN" so GitHub links them. -->
- Blocked by #<issue number>

## Design notes / open questions
<!-- Any [OPEN] markers from the REQ. Answer them here or leave for design review. -->

## Out of scope
<!-- What is explicitly NOT part of this issue.
     Prevents scope creep during review. -->
```
